handle_body.files: 1..256 unique file_ref records; sorted by logical_name UTF-8 bytes
handle_body.roles: exact role-to-logical-name map specified in required_roles

condition.id: one of six E01 condition IDs
condition.evidence_names: array of referenced logical names; empty allowed only with explicit missing/independence cause
condition.causal_conditions: array of condition IDs; no cycles

consumer_receipt.observed_handle_sha256: digest or null if missing/malformed handle
consumer_receipt.conditions: exactly six condition records in E01 order

closure_rule: Roles each resolve once; additional files only if transitively referenced by native profile/evidence/stage/tool closure. Every file digest checked and no unused files accepted. Raw record path identities must be four distinct native invocations.

functions.collect: IO: (trusted root, expected inputs, handle) -> immutable buffers plus typed acquisition failures; never sends mutable root to evaluator
functions.project: pure: (validated compiled graph, query) -> positive/negative provider graphs and full provenance map
functions.run: IO: (new workspace, frozen requests, exact runtime grants) -> retained native artifacts or typed execution failure
functions.evaluate: pure: (expected_inputs, handle, immutable buffers, acquisition failures, separately bound review input) -> six derived conditions and aggregate
functions.consume: separate implementation of collection and evaluation; no producer executable dependency

unknown_fields: reject at integration boundaries; native record fields follow pinned native protocol
native_nonpass: Inspect retained raw failures before mapping wrapper not_established; preserve observed counterexamples as BLOCK
independence_schedule: E03 separate consumer-source review before E04 acceptance; E05 final independent product review remains separate
